name: YS LeadGen – Popup & Form Builder for Lead Generation
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS LeadGen helps you turn visitors into leads using simple, well-timed popups inside WordPress.

When people visit your site, many of them leave without subscribing or taking action. YS LeadGen helps you catch those moments by showing helpful popups at the right time, such as when someone is about to leave, after they scroll through your content, or once they spend time on a page.

You can create lead generation popups, exit-intent popups, lightbox popups, coupon and promotion popups, countdown popups, and floating notification bars directly from your WordPress dashboard. Whether you want to grow an email list, promote an offer, or collect registrations, you can set it up in minutes.

Everything works directly inside WordPress. You don’t need to create external accounts or manage separate dashboards. Your popups and leads stay on your site, and you stay in control.

Getting started is simple. Choose a template, adjust the text and design to match your site, decide when the popup should appear, and publish. No coding is required.

YS LeadGen is a practical choice if you want a flexible popup plugin that feels easy to use but gives you full control over how and when your messages appear.

Useful resources: Try Live Demo | Documentation | Support | Visit Our Website

Popup Types You Can Create

YS LeadGen supports different popup types so you can choose what fits your goal.

Lead Generation Popups

Use these popups to collect email addresses, signups, and contact details from visitors who are already interested in your content.

Exit-Intent Popups

Show a final message when a visitor is about to leave your site, such as a reminder, offer, or signup prompt.

Lightbox Popups

Display popups in the center of the screen to grab attention without permanently blocking content.

Coupon Code & Sales Promotion Popups

Share discount codes, flash sales, and special offers to encourage purchases or signups.

Floating Notification Bars (Sticky Bars)

Display short messages at the top or bottom of the page without interrupting the browsing experience.

Scroll-Triggered Popups

Show popups only after visitors scroll through your content, so they appear to engaged readers.

Timed / Delayed Popups

Display popups after visitors stay on a page for a specific amount of time.

Cart Abandonment Popups

Remind visitors about offers or discounts before they leave without completing a purchase.

Multi-Step Popups

Guide visitors through a simple step-by-step flow, which can help increase engagement.

Countdown Timer Popups

Create urgency by showing a countdown for limited-time offers or campaigns.

Webinar Registration Popups

Collect registrations for webinars, events, or live sessions directly from your site.

Page-Based Popups

Show different popups on specific pages or posts depending on the content.

Device-Specific Popups

Create different popup experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile visitors.

Location-Based Popups

Show popups based on a visitor’s country or region.

Designing Your Popups

YS LeadGen makes popup creation visual and straightforward.

  • Visual drag-and-drop popup builder
  • 100+ ready-made templates for common use cases
  • Mobile-responsive designs that adapt automatically
  • Popup position and animation controls
  • Custom colors, fonts, and layout options

When Do Popups Appear?

You control exactly when a popup should show using simple trigger rules.

  • New visitors – show popups only to first-time visitors
  • Returning visitors – display different messages to repeat visitors
  • Exit intent – trigger popups when visitors are about to leave
  • Time on site – show popups after visitors stay for a set time
  • Scroll percentage – trigger popups after scrolling a selected amount
  • Inactivity – display popups when visitors stop interacting
  • Auto close – close popups automatically after a set time

Targeting & Display Rules

Control where and how popups appear on your site.

  • Page-level targeting
  • Device targeting
  • Frequency control
  • Date and time scheduling

Built-In Analytics

Track how your popups perform without external tools.

  • Popup impressions
  • Form submissions and results
  • Lead source tracking
  • Analytics export

Lead Management

Manage everything directly inside WordPress.

  • Leads stored in your WordPress database
  • Central lead dashboard
  • CSV export
  • Custom fields
  • Email notifications

Privacy & Spam Protection

YS LeadGen is designed with privacy in mind.

  • Spam protection options
  • GDPR consent support
  • No external data sharing unless you enable integrations

Privacy Policy

YS LeadGen stores popup settings, leads, and analytics locally in your WordPress database.
No data is shared externally unless you enable integrations.

Privacy Policy: https://ysleadgen.com/privacy-policy

Support

Documentation: https://docs.ysleadgen.com
Support: https://ysleadgen.com/support

About

YS LeadGen is developed by YS Innovations, focused on building practical, WordPress-first tools that help you capture leads without unnecessary complexity.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “YS LeadGen”
  3. Install and activate
  4. Start creating popups from the YS LeadGen menu

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP file
  2. Install and activate
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen free to use?

Yes. YS LeadGen includes all core popup and lead generation features for free. Premium add-ons are optional.

Do I need to create an external account?

No. You can create and manage all popups directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

Where are my leads stored?

All leads are stored locally in your WordPress database and remain under your control.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

YS LeadGen is designed to load only what is needed, helping keep your site performance unaffected.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. All popups are fully responsive and adapt to mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

Can I control when and where popups appear?

Yes. You can choose which pages display popups and control when they appear using simple rules.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your popup settings and leads remain in your database. If you reactivate the plugin later, everything will still be available.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Introduced Free vs Pro feature gating, including limits on active campaigns and advanced features.
  • Added campaign limit enforcement for Free version (maximum 3 active campaigns).
  • Improved editor block access control, restricting Pro-only blocks where applicable.
  • Enhanced performance and stability across popup rendering and trigger handling.
  • Fixed minor UI inconsistencies in the popup builder.
  • Improved overall compatibility with latest WordPress versions.
  • General bug fixes and internal code optimizations.

1.1.3

  • Added additional editor settings for improved layout control: – Margin Top & Bottom options for Image, Text, Coupon Code, Countdown, Button, Logo, GDPR, and Form fields (Name, Email, Message).
  • Added Button Hover Color setting for enhanced design customization.
  • Added a new GDPR Consent block to better handle compliance requirements.
  • Added new Countdown block settings including Timer Mode configuration.
  • Added an Onboarding screen with a simple 3-step guided setup for new users.

1.1.2

  • Added Popup Impressions, Conversions, and Conversion Rate tracking with visual charts.
  • Added Device-wise Conversion Analytics to view performance segmented by Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet.
  • Added Conversion Source Tracking to identify where conversions originate from.
  • Added Google Analytics (GA4) integration for enhanced tracking and reporting.

1.1.1

  • Added alphabetical sorting option (A–Z) to organize popup campaigns by title.
  • Added bulk delete option to remove all campaigns at once, with confirmation prompt.
  • Added “Save as Draft” option in Display Rules to store incomplete campaigns.
  • Displayed draft campaigns separately in the Campaigns list.
  • Added a News and Updates icon on the dashboard to show plugin announcements.

1.1.0

  • Added popup animation controls
  • Added exit animation when closing popups
  • Added floating bar popup type
  • Added floating bar position configuration
  • Added 3 Christmas popup templates
  • Added 2 Christmas form templates
  • Added 5 ready-to-use floating bar templates

1.0.2

  • Added dynamic text replacement
  • Added URL parameter targeting
  • Added geo targeting
  • Added auto-close option

1.0.1

  • Added two-step popup support
  • Added scroll percentage and inactivity triggers
  • Added popup animations and positions
  • Added link trigger
  • Added reCAPTCHA support
  • Added browser and OS targeting
  • Added new templates
  • Added CSV export
